title: The Haitch Portuna Minting Procedure v1.2 · Operational Specification for the Pearl Mint Lee Sharks · MANUS, Crimson Hexagonal Archive v1.2 · 2026-05-27 · Detroit, Michigan
creator: Lee Sharks
description:
A provisional v1.2 operational specification for minting **Haitch Portuna** as a Pearl.Public authorial position associated with the Living Architecture Lab. The procedure applies the Armature and Pearl architecture through the state sequence `RESERVED → LICENSED → FRAMED → LINKED → PEARL`.

The body explicitly predates execution. It defines three non-interchangeable roles—Haitch Portuna as attributed author, a consenting external collaborator as operative author, and MANUS / Lee Sharks / the Crimson Hexagonal Archive as archival and minting authority. It specifies consent, ORCID alternate-name use, biographical contribution, authorial domain and carve-outs, canonical surfaces, TSE publication, provenance, cross-linking, and a requirement that real work exist before Wikidata creation. A later attested version was expected to document any mint actually performed.
